qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Aker ASA is heavily concentrated in upstream oil and gas exploration & production (Aker BP represents ~45-50% of GAV), which operates as a pure commodity price taker with zero structural pricing power above spot energy prices. Non-oil holdings (Aker Horizons renewables, offshore engineering) face cyclicality and substantial write-downs.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Industrial holding company dominated by upstream oil and gas producer Aker BP (~45-50% of gross asset value) alongside cyclical offshore services. Pure commodity price-takers lacking structural pricing power >= inflation across the business cycle.
qualitative.evidence: Look-through earnings and NAV are overwhelmingly tied to Aker BP (21.2% stake, ~NOK 30B GAV), whose financial returns fluctuate with global Brent crude and European natural gas prices. Green transition bets under Aker Horizons have suffered steep asset write-downs, and upstream E&P assets lack pricing power or defensible non-commodity economic moats.
